overview_description.description:
XPay is a payment infrastructure company that gives Egyptian businesses control over their payment operations. As payments become a core part of how a business runs, XPay provides the systems to process them, see how they perform, and act on what the data shows — built on a foundation of transparency, clarity, and consistency. We compete on the quality of that infrastructure and the intelligence built into it, not on breadth of footprint or sales promises. The product is the proof.
Underpinning that is global-standard technology, built for Egypt. The architecture, developer tooling, and data layer match how the best modern platforms in the world are built. The market focus, payment methods, compliance, and support are tuned specifically to Egyptian businesses. We are deliberately single-market: XPay is built for Egypt, and that focus is a feature, not a limitation.

product.name: XPay Payment Gateway
product.description: An online payment gateway that processes various payment methods and provides transaction management through a unified dashboard.

product.name: Direct Order APIs
product.description: APIs that allow businesses to generate payment links and receive real-time transaction updates within their own systems.

product.name: Events & Ticketing Platform
product.description: A platform for managing events, ticket sales, and guest management with integrated payment processing.

product.name: Pay Button
product.description: An embeddable payment button for websites that enables quick and easy customer payments without coding.

product.name: Instant Payment Links
product.description: A service to create and send payment links for online payments without requiring a website.

product.name: Recurring Payments
product.description: A feature that automates billing cycles by enabling scheduled, repeated payments through the platform.
